_meta.description: Migrate4HANA value-mapping matrix. Each top-level key is a NAMED TABLE referenced by a VALUE_MAP transform rule in ruleset.json. Source values are matched case-insensitively after trim.
_meta.edit_workflow: 1) scripts\manage-value-maps.ps1 -Action pull   (downloads from S3)  2) edit this file in any text editor  3) scripts\manage-value-maps.ps1 -Action push   (uploads + validates)

company_code_map._doc: Legacy ECC BUKRS -> S/4 BUKRS. Used by Customer/Vendor/Material/GL/Asset objects.

currency_map._doc: Legacy ECC WAERS -> ISO 4217. Critical for FI postings; DEM/FRF/ITL drop to EUR.

country_map._doc: Legacy ECC LAND1 -> ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Most ECC values already match; this catches legacy aliases.

language_map._doc: Legacy ECC SPRAS -> ISO 639-1 (S/4 prefers ISO codes). Single-char ECC codes like 'E' get expanded.

material_type_map._doc: Legacy MARA.MTART -> S/4 material type. Most pass through unchanged; ZFG/ZHA/ZHB are legacy custom types we remap to standard.

customer_group_map._doc: Legacy KNA1.KTOKD -> S/4 BP grouping. 0001-class becomes BP01 in S/4 BP-led numbering.

vendor_group_map._doc: Legacy LFA1.KTOKK -> S/4 BP grouping for vendors.

gl_account_map._doc: Legacy SKA1.SAKNR remaps. Use sparingly - most accounts pass through; this is for the few that got renumbered in the S/4 design.

sales_org_map._doc: Legacy VKORG -> S/4 sales org. Often re-keyed during S/4 implementation.

plant_map._doc: Legacy WERKS -> S/4 plant. Plant consolidation is common during S/4 cutover; this table holds the merge map.
